description: Hourly flow data from hydropower facilities in CONUS is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Marshall, Adrienne M (deposited on HydroShare). This data resource supports Marshall & Grubert (2021). The study presents operational hydropower parameters calculated based on six years of hourly data from 158 dams, and estimates power generation in these hours based on monthly hydropower generation data reported to the Energy Information Administration (EIA). Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2021-06-22 and last updated 2022-07-28; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
